runtimeEntries.name: MENDPOINT_BACKUP_FENCE_ROOT
runtimeEntries.activatedBy: MENDPOINT_DEPLOYMENT_PROFILE=customer; required by both scripts/customer-backup.ts and operator-run npm run recovery:proof
runtimeEntries.note: Absolute root holding the mutation-fence marker both the backup and the recovery proof lease

runtimeEntries.name: MENDPOINT_BACKUP_KEY_ID
runtimeEntries.activatedBy: MENDPOINT_DEPLOYMENT_PROFILE=customer; required by both scripts/customer-backup.ts and operator-run npm run recovery:proof
runtimeEntries.note: Identifier of the active backup key; the key material itself is never a workflow input

runtimeEntries.name: MENDPOINT_DATA_DIR
runtimeEntries.activatedBy: MENDPOINT_DEPLOYMENT_PROFILE=customer; required by both scripts/customer-backup.ts and operator-run npm run recovery:proof
runtimeEntries.note: Live application data root, which the recovery proof must never restore into

runtimeEntries.name: MENDPOINT_ADAPTER_PROOF_SIGNING_KEY_B64
runtimeEntries.note: HMAC key used only to authenticate create-only adapter lifecycle proof reports

runtimeEntries.name: MENDPOINT_ADAPTER_PROOF_SIGNING_KEY_ID
runtimeEntries.note: Protected identifier for the adapter lifecycle proof signing key

runtimeEntries.name: MENDPOINT_ADAPTER_PROOF_VERIFICATION_KEYRING_JSON
runtimeEntries.note: Retained verification keys and revoked key identifiers for authenticating lifecycle proof reports across signing-key rotation

runtimeEntries.name: MENDPOINT_API_KEY
runtimeEntries.note: Bearer credential for the exact protected API origin used by the adapter lifecycle proof

runtimeEntries.name: MENDPOINT_API_BASE_URL
runtimeEntries.note: Exact protected API origin; proof inputs cannot select a different destination

runtimeEntries.name: MENDPOINT_ENVELOPE_KEY_CATALOG_JSON
runtimeEntries.note: Versioned envelope-key catalog for only the app instances that activate secret lifecycle operations

runtimeEntries.name: MENDPOINT_RECOVERY_BACKUP_ID
runtimeEntries.note: Identifier of the committed object backup the proof restores

runtimeEntries.name: MENDPOINT_RECOVERY_DEPLOYED_REVISION
runtimeEntries.note: Revision the operator expects to be deployed; the expectation, never the observation

runtimeEntries.name: MENDPOINT_RECOVERY_DEPLOYED_VERSION_URL
runtimeEntries.note: https /version endpoint of the running target, read to observe the deployed revision; required only for a production-targeted run

runtimeEntries.name: MENDPOINT_RECOVERY_ENVIRONMENT
runtimeEntries.note: local, synthetic, or production; only production observes a running deployment

runtimeEntries.name: MENDPOINT_RECOVERY_EVIDENCE_PATH
runtimeEntries.note: Absolute create-only path for the signed proof envelope

runtimeEntries.name: MENDPOINT_RECOVERY_PROOF_ID
runtimeEntries.note: Operator identifier for one proof run; also the replay binding

runtimeEntries.name: MENDPOINT_RECOVERY_REGION
runtimeEntries.note: Recovery region identifier; must differ from the source region

runtimeEntries.name: MENDPOINT_RECOVERY_REPOSITORY_REVISION
runtimeEntries.note: Repository revision the proof is recorded against

runtimeEntries.name: MENDPOINT_RECOVERY_ROLLBACK_ROOT
runtimeEntries.note: Absolute empty path for the pre-migration rollback snapshot

runtimeEntries.name: MENDPOINT_RECOVERY_SOURCE_REGION
runtimeEntries.note: Region the backup was taken from

runtimeEntries.name: MENDPOINT_RECOVERY_STAGING_ROOT
runtimeEntries.note: Absolute root the encrypted bundle is downloaded into

runtimeEntries.name: MENDPOINT_RECOVERY_TARGET_ROOT
runtimeEntries.note: Absolute empty isolated restore target; never the live data root

runtimeEntries.name: MENDPOINT_RECOVERY_TENANT_ID
runtimeEntries.note: Tenant label recorded in the signed envelope

runtimeEntries.name: MENDPOINT_SECRET_BREAK_GLASS
runtimeEntries.note: Explicit true or false break-glass policy binding

runtimeEntries.name: MENDPOINT_SECRET_IDEMPOTENCY_KEYRING_JSON
runtimeEntries.note: Versioned retained request-replay keyring with one active signing key

runtimeEntries.name: MENDPOINT_SECRET_LINEAGE_KEYRING_JSON
runtimeEntries.note: Distinct retained material-lineage keyring; must not reuse replay or envelope-key material

entries.name: MENDPOINT_RELEASE_DISPATCH_CONSUMERS_JSON
entries.gatedBy: release dispatch storage, service principal provisioning, drain, heartbeat, and paging remain unopened until at least one exact catalog.release-dispatch.v1 tenant binding is configured
entries.note: identifier-only tenant and service-principal bindings; repository content and credentials are prohibited

entries.name: MENDPOINT_RELEASE_DISPATCH_RECONCILIATION_PRINCIPAL_ID
entries.gatedBy: the reconciliation CLI fails closed unless an active tenant-bound human or dedicated reconciliation service principal is bound and differs from the dispatch worker
entries.note: identifier only; this binding grants no dispatch execution authority
